No provider addition detected in provider-neutral ACS Core files under /app/src/.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Confirmed no forbidden billable calls were made in this run. AUDIT-01 for project d8c5c6a5 passed including browser download completion, usable filename, exact byte/hash match with stored artifact, WebM magic, content-type video/webm, content-disposition attachment (with download=1), and byte ranges. Azarine checks are blocked by 404 under provided credentials; local file /app/.data/audit-azarine-export.json is ~3.8MB with 4 images and 5331-char creativeInstruction, but root export keys still omit productIntelligence/provenance.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 (Azarine 404): project ccfcf412-b054-47f0-a43d-c71733e352d7 exists in persisted state but is owned by a different userId than the provided demo credential account. Repro: login as acs.demo@local.test -> GET /api/projects/{ccfc...} => 404. Mitigation: align seed ownership or credential mapping. RCA-2 (Export schema gap): canonical export endpoint returns {...result, exportMetadata} where result lacks root-level productIntelligence/provenance; these are nested only. Repro: UI download-project-button and GET /api/projects/{id}/export outputs. Mitigation: include explicit root sections per export contract requirement.
